title: GoodWe HCA G2 GW11K-HCA-20 (11 kW three-phase EV charger, 7.5 m cable)

items.question: Does the 11 kW charger still need an external Type A RCD?
items.answer: Yes. The datasheet lists under Protection: "External Type A RCD is needed". The technical data table for GW11K-HCA-20 states: "An external Type A residual current device (RCD) is required."
items.question_de: Braucht das 11-kW-Ladegerät noch einen externen FI Typ A?
items.answer_de: Ja. Im Datenblatt steht unter Schutz: „External Type A RCD is needed“. In den technischen Daten für GW11K-HCA-20 steht: „An external Type A residual current device (RCD) is required.“

items.question: What comes with the charger?
items.answer: The scope of delivery includes: Charger x 1, AC connector x 1, Dummy socket x 1, fastening screws x 4, Expansion bolt x 4, RS485 communication connector x 1, LAN communication connector x 1, Screwdriver x 1, AC cable pin terminal x 2, RS485 cable pin terminal x 1, RFID card x 5, RJ45 terminal x 4, Waterproof rubber plug x 2, Documents x 1.
items.answer_de: Zum Lieferumfang gehören: Charger x 1, AC connector x 1, Dummy socket x 1, Befestigungsschrauben x 4, Expansion bolt x 4, RS485 communication connector x 1, LAN communication connector x 1, Schraubendreher x 1, AC cable pin terminal x 2, RS485 cable pin terminal x 1, RFID card x 5, RJ45 terminal x 4, Waterproof rubber plug x 2, Documents x 1.

items.question: Is GW11K-HCA-20 prepared for §14a EnWG?
items.answer: The manual describes an EnWG 14a setting: "EnWG 14a: According to the German EnWG (Energy Industry Act) 14a, all SteuVEs (controllable loads) need to be subject to emergency dimming by the grid. The grid operator can temporarily reduce the maximum grid-bought power consumption of controllable loads to 4.2 kW. If only need to use DI4-EnWG 14a, other DI ports no need to wire."
items.answer_de: Das Handbuch beschreibt eine EnWG-14a-Einstellung: „EnWG 14a: According to the German EnWG (Energy Industry Act) 14a, all SteuVEs (controllable loads) need to be subject to emergency dimming by the grid. The grid operator can temporarily reduce the maximum grid-bought power consumption of controllable loads to 4.2 kW. If only need to use DI4-EnWG 14a, other DI ports no need to wire.“
